openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: ZyXEL's more advanced SOHO 802.11ax/WiFi 6 access point, designed for wall/ceiling mount, includes a 12v2A power supply, and also PoE support, along side an easily accessible console port, reset button and multi-color LED. Compared to the NWA50AX it adds 160Mhz channels and a 2.5GB ethernet interface. The NWA90AX Pro is hardware wise identical to the NWA50AX Pro.
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: You do not need to remove the case to access to the console serial port on this device. On the bottom side of the device, there are 4 PH1 screws, remove them, flip the device over and pry the top cover off from the ridge around the edge.
openwrt_wiki.Serial: externally accessible serial port, 3.3v logic level UART (not RS232); standard 2.54mm (0.1 inch) spaced header pins; Remove the soft plastic dust plug next to the Ethernet port. Pin 1: 3.3v OUTPUT ("▲" is printed on the case next to this pin). Pin 2: Transmit data from AP. Pin 3: Receive data to AP. Pin 4: GND/reference. If in doubt, leave pin 1 unconnected.
openwrt_wiki.Installation: Install is via either the built-in web interface of the OEM firmware, or via TFTP (externally accessible serial console). OEM firmware dual image: Current Image num must be 1 before installing OpenWrt factory image via Maintenance > File Manager > Firmware Package; otherwise flash an OEM firmware upgrade first. Default OEM: DHCP client, fallback 192.168.1.2, user admin, password on the back of the device or 1234.
openwrt_wiki.Debricking: You may need to set the Ethernet interface on your connected computer to 100M mode in order to successfully transfer files using tftp.
openwrt_wiki.Bootlog U-Boot: U-Boot 2022.07-rc3 (Jan 05 2023), CPU MediaTek MT7981, Model mt7981-rfb, DRAM 512 MiB, Winbond SPI NAND 256 MiB (block 128 KiB, page 2048, OOB 128), NMBM, Zyxel version V1.08
openwrt_wiki.Link Flapping: see issue https://github.com/openwrt/openwrt/issues/14192; workaround: ethtool -s eth0 advertise 0x028 (1000baseT Full + 100baseT Full, exclude 2500baseT), GPY211

openwrt_git.UART Console: Available below the rubber cover next to the ethernet port. Settings: 115200 8N1. Layout: <12V> <LAN> GND-RX-TX-VCC. Logic-Level is 3V3. Don't connect VCC to your UART adapter!
openwrt_git.Installation Web-UI: Upload the Factory image using the devices Web-Interface. Dual-image layout: OpenWrt can only be installed on Slot A; current active image must be Slot B prior flashing; otherwise first install a ZyXEL firmware upgrade.
openwrt_git.Installation TFTP / Recovery: via UART console and bootloader TFTP (initramfs), then sysupgrade
